sections.html:
Two jobs, clearly split

LeadPro does

  • Puts every new lead on your lead board: website leads as Web Lead, phone leads as Phone Lead
  • Sends every new lead 3 emails over 2 days, starting the moment they reach out
  • Confirms each consultation by email as soon as it's booked
  • Reminds the lead 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before the consultation (3 emails and 2 texts)
  • Texts your team whenever a contact replies by text, email or call
  • Keeps every text and email in one inbox

Your team keeps doing

  • Calling every new lead
  • Tagging a caller “phone lead” after the call, so they get the emails too
  • Booking the consultation
  • Holding the consultation and signing the client
  • Answering replies

On this page, “messages” means both texts and emails. Nothing is sent until you approve the wording on your review page.

sections.html:
Messaging rules built in

Nothing goes out until you approveAll three automations are built in LeadPro and switched off.
New leads hear from you right awayThe first email goes out the moment a lead reaches out.
Reminders follow the appointmentThey're timed from the consultation: 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before.
Every reply reaches your teamWhen a contact replies by text, email or call, your team gets a text with what they said.

Where things stand

Everything on this page is built in your LeadPro account and switched off. Nothing goes to a lead until you're happy with it. Here's how it goes live:

  1. You review the wording and answer the open items

    Change anything you'd like in the messages, and send us the answers below.

  2. We make your changes and send a test lead through

    We fill in the blanks, set up your booking calendar and Zoom link, and check every message arrives as written.

  3. We switch it on and walk your team through it

    Your leads start getting the messages as soon as it's on.
